youtube_title: Jesus... I Told Amma I’m Busy. I’m Not. | Exodus 20:12 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus to a real, unspoken prayer.

He told his mother he is too busy to come home for Diwali. The truth is he did not want her to see how his year went.

He: Jesus... Amma asked me to come home for Diwali. I said I’m busy. I’m not. 📱
He: I booked nothing. I just didn’t want her to see how this year went.
Jesus: You told Me the year went badly. Did you think she couldn’t carry that too?
He: She’ll ask why I look thinner. What do I tell her?
Jesus: Tell her the truth. She raised you on harder sentences than that.
Jesus: Honor isn’t a perfect report card. It’s showing up before the lamps are lit.

“Honor your father and mother, so that your days may be long in the land that the LORD your God is giving you.”
Exodus 20:12 (BSB)

Honor isn’t a perfect report card. It’s showing up before the lamps are lit.

💬 When did you last just show up at home? 👇

An imagined reply. The Scripture is quoted as written.
